title: The New Zealand Rose Society — Rose Finder

common.preserved_uncertainty: Coverage of New Zealand-available cultivars not established (AF-19); states some roses fit more than one category.

content.identity: The New Zealand Rose Society, "Rose Finder", https://nzroses.org.nz/rose-finder/, accessed 27 September 2026 (FRD code NZRS-F)
content.relevance: A searchable cultivar directory giving a Type for each listed rose; the verification route for a named cultivar whose type is unknown (R-3). Also omits Grandiflora from its Type list (AF-4).
